headline: WiCi One: External GPU ditches cables for Wi-Fi 7 gaming and AI
summary: This new external GPU uses Wi-Fi 7 to deliver high-end graphics performance to any compatible device, eliminating the need for Thunderbolt or OCuLink cables.
details: WiCi is launching the WiCi One, an external GPU that connects wirelessly via Wi-Fi 7. This innovative solution allows users to harness the power of a dedicated graphics card for demanding tasks like gaming and AI without being tethered by cables.

The WiCi One houses its own graphics card, Wi-Fi 7 module, and cooling system within a single unit. The base model features an Nvidia RTX 5060 Ti with 16GB of VRAM, an Intel Core 3 100U CPU, and 1TB of NVMe storage.

For those seeking even more power, a higher-end variant will be available with an RTX 5090 32GB GPU, an Intel Core Ultra 7 225H processor, and a 4TB NVMe 5 SSD. This configuration is designed to handle the most graphically intensive applications.

WiCi claims the base model can achieve 80 fps in Cyberpunk 2077 at 4K Ultra settings with DLSS 4, and 60 fps in Black Myth: Wukong at 4K Cinematic with DLSS 4. The device is also marketed for its ability to accelerate heavy AI workloads and run local AI assistants.

Preorders for the WiCi One base model are open at $1,999, with an expected retail price of $2,599. Shipping is slated to begin in the fourth quarter of this year. Pricing for the RTX 5090 version will be announced closer to its launch.

topic: minecraft getting new dimension called the sift in 2027
headline: Minecraft adds new dimension 'The Sift' in 2027
summary: The first new dimension in over 15 years, The Sift will arrive in Java and Bedrock Editions after debuting in Minecraft Dungeons 2.
details: After more than a decade, Minecraft is finally introducing a new dimension called The Sift. This marks the first major dimension addition since The End was released in 2011.
The Sift will first appear in Minecraft Dungeons 2, with a release date set for September 29. It will then be integrated into the main Minecraft game for Java and Bedrock editions in 2027.

While details are scarce, Mojang Studios has revealed that The Sift will feature new areas like the Meadows and the Carapace. Players can expect new mobs that can be either companions or threats, and 'new rules to learn' regarding gameplay mechanics.

A teaser video showcased a glimpse of the dimension's unique aesthetic and a new mob. The developers have hinted at significant gameplay changes that will require players to adapt to the dimension's unique challenges.
